fields.description: Windsor House marks Ellington’s first development in Dubai South. Two L-shaped buildings frame a courtyard, with studios and one- to three-bedroom homes above ground-floor retail. Pools, Pilates, family lawns and dedicated pet areas give the shared spaces a practical role in daily life.
